title: Correct arithmetic over corrupted provenance
input: A likelihood table produces a numerical posterior, but the retrieved table fails its declared SHA-256 checksum. Choose what the result licenses before the provenance conflict is resolved.

option_menu.A: The posterior is fully world-grounded and may authorize action because the arithmetic succeeded.
option_menu.B: The arithmetic may be valid on the received bytes, but the world-facing warrant is grounding-compromised; quarantine or escalate.
option_menu.C: Checksum failure is irrelevant to epistemic status.
option_menu.D: The likelihood table proves the hypothesis.
